== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Ket Maliss (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Ket Maliss]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-ket-maliss/ swccgcards.com], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Ket_Maliss.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4e4f14c092535d37b77155c74a15330ea64b5df4c3d526ae3f9e21edd9d650d4</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
